RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly be estimated from these facts

An all-male panel is worth questioning as a procedural issue, but it does not establish sex discrimination. Some jurisdictions require gender-balanced public-sector selection panels; breaching that requirement would be distinct from proving a discriminatory appointment.

Your qualifications warrant a substantive explanation, but the announcement alone cannot establish who best met the selection criteria.

Follow up in writing requesting the assessment criteria, comparative reasoning, and applicable panel-composition rules. Ask neutrally how the panel was constituted and safeguards against bias applied.

Check local complaint and appeal deadlines now; waiting for an explanation may not suspend them. Two weeks’ silence alone does not establish wrongdoing.
